title: Computational design and reproducibility audit of candidate betaine-responsive circuits in Corynebacterium glutamicum
description:
Version 0.6.0 of a computational design resource containing 97 candidate DNA fragments (73 output fragments and 24 sensor candidates), analysis scripts, source provenance, figures, audit records and a working manuscript. The complete 427-file resource is packaged in cglut-betaine-circuit-v0.6.0.tar.xz; selected current candidates and audit scripts are also exposed directly in the repository.

No functioning circuit, engineered strain or experimental induction is reported. Biological function is untested. Recorded computational reruns were AI-executed; personal author verification and final manuscript declarations remain pending.

The lightweight candidate audit runs on the included files. The recorded 38-file reproduction comparison used a complete cached-input review package. Fourteen third-party cached inputs are excluded from the public archive; exact paths, hashes and provenance are documented in excluded_inputs.csv and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Full pipeline reproduction requires restoring these dependencies lawfully. This public resource is not a self-contained reproduction of every recorded stage.

Original code is MIT-licensed. Original design and analysis data are licensed under CC BY 4.0, subject to source rights. Third-party assets retain their original terms. The manuscript publication license remains pending; see LICENSE-SCOPE.txt.
